description: Retrieves a chat certificate: status, code, name, the certified message range (chatMessagesFrom/To), validity dates and certifiedAt. Requires: chat_certificate_create → id, chatId and the chat's caseFileId. CERTIFYING → CERTIFIED, or back to DRAFT if certification fails (then create a new one with chat_certificate_create); poll this tool until CERTIFIED or DRAFT. When CERTIFIED the response also carries documentUrl.

caseFileId.description: UUID of the case file that owns the chat

id.description: UUID of the certificate to retrieve

name: chat_certificate_get
